# Changelog

## Unreleased

### Changed

- Split MotionCore Vehicle into a free Basic/Core package and a separate
  Simulation Plugin.
- Moved `SimCarController` and simulation-specific tuning out of the free core.
- Updated free-core namespaces to `MotionCore.Vehicle.*`.
- Reduced the free input component to keyboard and gamepad support.
- Updated the free demo scene builder so it creates only a basic arcade demo.

### Added

- Added Simulation Plugin package folder and documentation.
- Added a simulation demo scene builder in the Simulation Plugin.
